description:
A written coding lesson: typed, and keyed when it is a state or a pitfall.

``turn_context`` is the context JSON of the turn the lesson was learned in (the
plugin's ``date``, ``end_commit``, ``branch``, ...), attached after the writer call;
a private attribute, so the LLM schema does not carry it.

accept.description: True to persist this lesson, False to drop it.
accept.title: Accept

reason.description: Why the lesson was rejected, when accept is False.
reason.title: Reason

statement.description: Standalone, entity-anchored prose for the lesson, when accepted.
statement.title: Statement

entities.description: Glossary entity names used in the statement.
entities.title: Entities

why_learned.description: One sentence naming the situation it was learned in.
why_learned.title: Why Learned

lesson_type.description: What the lesson is: location, pitfall, convention, constraint, change, state or other.
lesson_type.title: Lesson Type

state_key.description: Only for lesson_type 'state': 'test-baseline' or 'footprint:<feature>'. Empty for every other type.
state_key.title: State Key

title: CodingWrittenLesson
